{{Quote|One on your tail, Renegade Seven! Scissor right! Scissor right!|Renegade Four, Battle of Derra IV|<ref name="Radio" />}}
The '''scissors''' was a timed maneuver aimed at bringing an attacking [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] into the sights of the defending craft during a [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]]. The move, consisting of sharp, twisting turns, was generally executed immediately after the attacker overshot during a head-to-head engagement or following a successful [[break]]ing maneuver. This tactic was fairly difficult to time and required constant monitoring of one's opponent.<ref name="RASB" />

During the [[Battle of Derra IV]], [[Renegade Four]] ordered [[Renegade Seven]] to scissor right to avoid a pursuing enemy fighter.<ref name="Radio" />
